image_description: A close-up, ground-level shot of a white daisy-like flower lying on dark, clumpy soil. The flower head is partially obscured by out-of-focus green grass blades in the foreground. The petals are white and elongated, radiating from a yellowish-green center that appears somewhat textured but also slightly muddy or damaged. Green serrated leaves are visible near the flower base.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The center of the flower lacks the distinct, crisp granular texture of real disc florets. It appears slightly smeared or 'muddy,' blending into the inner petals without clear definition.
The connection points between the white petals and the yellow center are slightly soft and ill-defined. Some petals seem to merge into the center rather than attaching distinctly.
The extreme blur of the foreground grass is natural for depth of field, but the transition edges show slight haloing/bleeding against the soil, typical of AI generation.
